estimated_recovery_rate: No final universal recovery rate; the proposed class settlement described an expected net settlement of approximately $4 million for pro rata distribution, while earlier company-plan payments and possible SEC distributions remain separate.
repayment_method: Earlier company plan payments, a proposed class-settlement liquidating trust, and possible separate regulatory distributions
notes: MyConstant had returned some funds after closing, but prior plan payments were later terminated. The court-authorized settlement site described a proposed liquidating trust and pro rata distributions subject to the settlement process. CYA does not treat the case as completed repayment or assign a customer-wide percentage.
